common_pitfalls_editing_checkers.common_error_or_misconception: Changing the sign of a term when moving it without proper operation balancing (e.g. thinking 2x = 8 means x = 8 - 2).
common_pitfalls_editing_checkers.correct_fact_or_method: 2x represents multiplication, so its inverse is division: x = 8 / 2 = 4.

common_pitfalls_editing_checkers.common_error_or_misconception: Distributing a factor to only the first term inside parentheses (e.g. 3(x + 2) = 3x + 2).
common_pitfalls_editing_checkers.correct_fact_or_method: Multiply the factor across ALL terms inside parentheses: 3(x + 2) = 3x + 6.
